name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted TLS certificate manager to issue, renew, inventory and deploy certificates through ACME with DNS-01 providers, plus a web UI and REST API.

alerts.message: The first page creates the administrator account and asks for the API bearer token: copy the generated API_BEARER_TOKEN value from this deployment's environment variables. Public certificates are usually validated through DNS-01, which needs credentials for a supported DNS provider, added in Settings.
